title: Antiproliferative effects of resorcylic acid lactones from the Beibu Gulf coral-derived fungus Curvularia lunata GXIMD 02512 on prostate cancer cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2024, 14,38697-38705
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06292B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jiaxi Wang, Humu Lu, Wenxuan Fang, Miaoping Lin, Yuyao Feng, Xin Qi, Chenghai Gao, Yonghong Liu, Xueni Wang, Xiaowei Luo
A new RAL, curvulomycin A (1), was found to inhibit cell viability, proliferation, and clone formation. It further arrested G1 phase and induced apoptosis (34.2%) in 22Rv1 cells.
